# Wedison Bali

> Consumer information for electric motorcycles in Bali. Bali OTR prices and BAAS subscriptions are separate purchase options.

## Bali SuperCharge status

Checked 2026-11-07: 4 locations confirmed operating in owner-supplied Wedison SuperCharge app screenshots. This is a dated observation, not a live availability feed. The other 16 directory locations require current confirmation.

- Gedung By Pas 55: Jl. Bypass Ngurah Rai No.888XX, Pemogan, Denpasar Selatan, Kota Denpasar, Bali 80221
- Gedung E-Sanur: Jl. Bypass Ngurah Rai No.15, Sanur, Denpasar Selatan, Kota Denpasar, Bali 80227
- Gedung Malboro: Jl. Teuku Umar Barat No.7-9, Denpasar Barat, Kota Denpasar, Bali
- Gedung Tohpati: Jl. WR Supratman No.109, Denpasar Timur, Kota Denpasar, Bali
